scope: Mutable static-state census of every .cs file under src/RackCad.Plugin/Drawing (14), src/RackCad.Plugin/Systems (15) and src/RackCad.Plugin/KindHandlers (9) at commit 3375aadb (extract root main2). Method: grep of every line with the `static` token (100 lines, all read), plus greps for event, ThreadStatic/ThreadLocal, Lazy, Random, Concurrent, StringBuilder, ModuleInitializer, static constructors, `partial` classes and settable properties. Each hit was then read in context. Reachability was traced through the seam files outside scope (RackSelectivoCommands.cs, RackMenuCommands.cs, Application LibraryBlockRequirements.cs, KindDispatch.cs, BlockLibrary.cs). Result: 7 static members in scope. Only one real piece of mutable state sits on a seam path: the 4-field block-library side-database cache in BlockLibraryDatabaseCache. No static events, [ThreadStatic]/ThreadLocal, static constructors, module initializers, Lazy<T>, Random, or partial classes exist in scope.

entries.warmup_risk: REAL (FACT from code). A warm-up that draws a Selective frontal/planta into a scratch side database missing any library block, with the library file present, runs ReadDwgFile once and keeps the parsed library Database for the rest of the process. The cache key does NOT include the target/side database (:25-28). A later governed run with the same resolved path and an unchanged file (same mtime and length) therefore gets a cache hit (:30). Consequences: (a) the governed run never runs ReadDwgFile, so the read-failure diagnostic RackLog.Exception at :44 cannot fire in it; (b) WblockCloneObjects (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:123) clones from the SAME Database instance the warm-up already used. UNCERTAIN whether earlier clones or paging change that instance in a way visible to later clones (AutoCAD API behavior, not in code); (c) the first-read cost moves out of the governed run. Neutral cases: if the governed target already has every needed block, the cache is never touched (BlockLibraryImporter.cs:82-85). If the resolved path differs (settings override changed between runs), the governed run disposes the warm-up instance (:49) and reads the file again. A file replaced with the same length and LastWriteTimeUtc would be served stale (FACT from the key; unlikely in practice). A failed read is not cached (:42-47). The EnsureBlocks return value does not depend on hit or miss. UNCERTAIN: whether the open side database keeps an OS handle on blocks-library.dwg without CloseInput (AutoCAD semantics).

AutoCAD runtime behavior is UNCERTAIN because it is not visible in code: whether a Database read with ReadDwgFile(OpenForReadAndAllShare) and no CloseInput keeps the file handle open, and whether WblockCloneObjects changes the cached source Database's state between calls.

Static analysis only; nothing was built or run. Detection was grep-based on the `static` token plus the keyword greps listed in scope. State mutated through reflection or by AutoCAD itself would not be detected.
